title: finding(skills): the seat mutex's reading 3 counts `Claim:` only on `pm:dispatched` cards — a session re-engaged on a `pm:queue` card's branch is invisible to it (collision measured 2026-09-05)
body:
**Shift-end finding for the skills lane** (category: 可机械化项 — a check whose predicate is too narrow). Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01BAZFhALsQsGqxui8sNqM8s`, shift 2026-09-05. The skills seat grades; the execution seat proposes no text.

## The reading, verbatim from `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` §入口与角色

> 读数三：本车道 `pm:dispatched` 卡最新非本 session 的 `Claim:` 评论，只计认领本车道派发的。

## What it missed this shift

A different session (`session_0114Ytxr5sM1vdW19Y9WAx6E`, login `os-sam`) was driving objectui#7122's chain on PR #7685 while that card sat in `pm:queue` (claimed by THIS seat, not by that session — its work was a continuation of a prior shift's branch, recorded at objectui#7122 comment 5552811950). Reading 3 filters on `pm:dispatched`, so a session pushing to `refs/heads/claude/issue-7122-*` with the card in `pm:queue` produced no reading; the collision was found by reading the branch tip and the PR's commits, not by the mutex. Recorded on the seat post objectui#5734 §4 ("The mutex's reading 3 only counts `Claim:` on `pm:dispatched` cards").

## Mechanizable shape (observation only)

- Reading 3 could take `pm:dispatched` ∪ `pm:queue` cards whose `refs/heads/claude/issue-N*` branch moved since the last shift-end brief (a `git ls-remote` per card is cheap; the seat already probes queue refs the same way), and count a remote push as evidence of a live session even without a `Claim:` comment.
- Alternatively the rule "a branch push on a `pm:queue` card is a claim" could be stated, so the pusher owes the `Claim:` comment that reading 3 counts.

Refs: objectui#7122, PR objectstack-ai/objectui#7685, objectui#5734 (seat post §4), `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` §入口与角色 (开轮互斥).
